title: PixCon: Clean-Positive Contrastive Learning for Foundation-Model Semi-Supervised Segmentation
abstract: arXiv:2607.03068v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Can a simple labeled-pixel contrastive branch improve semi-supervised segmentation with a strong pretrained encoder? We study this question with PixCon, which adds a class-wise memory bank to a DINOv2-Base implementation of UniMatch V2. The bank stores ground-truth-labeled features only where the student prediction agrees with the label. A multi-positive contrastive loss uses these features to train the shared encoder-decoder; the head and bank are discarded at inference. This simplifies earlier labeled-pixel banks by removing confidence thresholds and learned ranking. On Pascal VOC with 183 labels, PixCon improves all three paired seeds by 0.20, 0.64 and 1.83 mIoU points, raising the mean from 87.01 to 87.90. With 92 labels the mean gain is 0.40 points; single-seed differences on Cityscapes and ADE20K range from -0.08 to +0.14 points. translated_title: PixCon：面向基础模型半监督分割的干净正样本对比学习
translated_abstract: arXiv:2607.03068v2 公告类型： replace-cross 摘要：一个简单的有标签像素对比分支能否在使用强大预训练编码器的半监督分割中带来提升？我们通过 PixCon 研究了这一问题。PixCon 在基于 DINOv2-Base 的 UniMatch V2 实现上添加了一个按类别划分的记忆库，该记忆库仅存储学生预测与真实标签一致位置处的有标签特征。多正样本对比损失利用这些特征来训练共享的编码器-解码器，而在推理阶段头部和记忆库会被丢弃。这通过去除置信度阈值和学习的排序机制，简化了先前的有标签像素记忆库方法。在仅使用 183 个标签的 Pascal VOC 上，PixCon 使三个配对随机种子的 mIoU 分别提升 0.20、0.64 和 1.83 个点，平均值从 87.01 提高到 87.90。使用 92 个标签时平均提升 0.40 个点；在 Cityscapes 和 ADE20K 上的单种子差异范围为 -0.08 至 +0.14 个点。一个使用预测标签进行对比学习的对照实验达到了几乎相同的 Pascal 精度，因此这些结果……
tldr: PixCon 通过添加一个仅存储预测与真实标签一致处的干净有标签特征、无需置信度阈值的类别级记忆库，并以多正样本对比损失训练编码器-解码器，从而以极简方式显著提升了基于基础模型的半监督分割性能。
en_tdlr: PixCon improves foundation-model semi-supervised segmentation by adding a class-wise memory bank that stores only clean labeled features where predictions match ground truth, trained with a multi-positive contrastive loss and without confidence thresholds.
